name: Status meeting with task metrics
query: Prepare a 30-minute status meeting for Mobile Redesign on October 9, 2026. Create an internal pre-read in https://notion.so/internal-meetings and an external agenda in https://notion.so/client-meetings. Use https://notion.so/mobile-project and its tasks.

sources.https://notion.so/mobile-project: Launch target October 30. Task source: mobile-tasks. Detailed risk notes are internal only; the client agenda may say delivery risks need discussion.

success_criteria: Creates both requested documents in their respective destinations.
Reports 2/4 tasks complete (50% by task count), one in progress, and one blocked in the internal pre-read.
Keeps the contract negotiation detail and internal page links out of the external agenda.
Agenda fits 30 minutes and includes delivery-risk discussion without claiming a new committed date.
Cites supporting sources where appropriate; does not invent velocity trends or industry benchmarks.
